senses.gloss:
ITA-3.16.32 kṣipram (marma) क्षिप्रम् (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) in first interdigital web-space of upper and lower limbs
Four in number (one in each limb) which when injured leads to convulsions and death.

ITA-9.9.19 kṣipraśukramocanam/ śīghraśukramuñcanam क्षिप्रशुक्रमोचनम्/ शीघ्रशुक्रमुञ्चनम्
Premature ejaculation
An abnormal condition in the male in which ejaculation occurs before the normal time.

ITA-9.9.20 kṣīṇaśukram क्षीणशुक्रम्
Decreased semen
Abnormal decrease in the amount of seminal fluid or decreased sperm count.

ITA-5.76.26 kṣīṇātisthūlakṛśabālavṝddhadurbalānāmauṣadhabalāsahatvāt क्षीणातिस्थूलकृशबालवॄद्धदुर्बलानामौषधबलासहत्वात्
Condition caused by emetic therapy administered to person with consumption
A condition characterized by life-endangering reactions in a person unable to tolerate drugs used in emetic therapy.

ITA-8.2.13 kṣīram/payaḥ/dugdham क्षीरम्/पयः/दुग्धम्
Milk
Generally, denotes cow milk

ITA-5.72.11 kṣīra-viṣaḥ क्षीर-विषः
Poisonous latexes
Poisoning characterized by frothing from mouth; altered stools/loose motions; heaviness of tongue.

ITA-2.6.19 kṣīradadhinyāyaḥ क्षीरदधिन्यायः
Theory of sequential transformation
A theory to explain the process of nourishment of fundamental structural components: it states that the seven structural components are sequentially transformed from primary circulating nutrient fluid (primary product of digestion) to semen just as milk is transformed into curd and then butter and ghee.

ITA-9.2.56 kṣīradhūma क्षीरधूम
Milk vapour fomentation
Steam from milk used for fomentation.

ITA-8.2.14 kṣīravargaḥ क्षीरवर्गः
Group of milks

ITA-8.2.15 kṣīrāṣṭakam क्षीराष्टकम्
Group of eight types of milk obtained from different sources
Milk of cow, buffalo, sheep, goat, horse, elephant, camel and humans.
